craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vidhi unit 26. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 11. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: With little finger having opened mouth, with index fingers eyebrows so; with ring finger, with middle finger in mouth, with tongue palate should touch.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kaniṣṭhayā vidāryāsyaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ bhruvau tathā anāme madhyame vaktre jihvayā tālukaṃ spṛśet
